basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Nagpur Medical Physicist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Nagpur (AIIMS Nagpur) has announced 2 vacancies for the Medical Physicist (Radiation Oncology) post on a contract basis for a period of 11 (Eleven) Months under advertisement number AIIMS/NGP/RECT/CONT/26 November 2803. The notified pay is Rs. 86,955 per month, and applicants must possess an M.Sc. in Medical Physics or equivalent from a recognized University/Institution OR M.Sc. in Physics with Post-Graduate diploma/degree in Radiological Medical Physics OR M.Sc. in Medical Technology with Radiotherapy. Candidates can apply online by making an online pay

how_to_apply: Pay the application fee of Rs. 1,000/- (if applicable) through NEFT using the bank account details provided by AIIMS Nagpur.
Fill out the application form via the official Google form link: Google Form Link.
Upload or send a copy of the payment receipt along with the application form and all relevant copies of certificates and testimonials.
Ensure the complete application reaches through the Google form by 26.10.2026 till 05:00 pm.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Medical Physicist (Radiation Oncology) at a Glance

Rs. 1,000/- for General/OBC/EWS; Exempted for PwBD/SC/ST

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment offers a total of 2 vacancies under the unreserved category for the Medical Physicist (Radiation Oncology) position.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the essential educational qualifications and experience requirements as of the last date of submission of application.

rows.essential_qualification_experience: M.Sc. in Medical Physics or equivalent from a recognized University/Institution. OR i) M.Sc. in Physics from a recognized University. ii) A Post-Graduate diploma/degree in Radiological Medical Physics from a recognized University/Institute. OR M.Sc. in Medical Technology with Radiotherapy as special subject from a recognized University and/or Diploma in Radiation Protection. And 2 Years experience of working in Radiotherapy Department of a Hospital.
rows.desirable_qualification: An approval from the competent authority to function as Radiological Safety Officer (RSO).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 86,955/- per month with no enhancement during the contract period. The appointment is strictly on a contractual basis for a period of 11 (Eleven) months or until regular appointments are made, whichever is earlier. The contract period may be extended based on institute requirements and satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Nagpur Medical Physicist (Radiation Oncology)
content_sections.text: Pay the application fee of Rs. 1,000/- (if applicable) through NEFT using the bank account details provided by AIIMS Nagpur. Fill out the application form via the official Google form link: Google Form Link . Upload or send a copy of the payment receipt along with the application form and all relevant copies of certificates and testimonials. Ensure the complete application reaches through the Google form by 26.10.2026 till 05:00 pm.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of candidates for the interview will be based on educational qualification, relevant experience, and/or short-listing criteria decided by the Executive Director, AIIMS Nagpur. If a large number of applications are received, a screening test may be conducted. Scrutiny of applications and document verification will be conducted prior to the interview. Candidates must score minimum qualifying marks (suitability standard) fixed by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q1. Is this Medical Physicist position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely on a contractual basis for a period of 11 (Eleven) months or until regular appointments are made, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit and relaxation for the post?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 21 to 35 years as on the last date of submission of application. Government of India rules apply for reservation and relaxations.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on their educational qualifications, relevant experience, or through a screening test if a large number of applications are received.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee and who is exempted?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1,000/- for General/OBC/EWS candidates. Candidates belonging to PwBD, SC, and ST categories are exempted from paying the application fee.
